fact_previews: The Jody Project was inspired by the founder's experiences attending funerals and questioning the quality of memorial services.
The founder initially shelved the idea of starting a new funeral company after considering the funeral industry for a few weeks.
The founder's friend, Jody, was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer and died six weeks later, which motivated the creation of The Jody Project.
For Jody's celebration of life, a friend named Jesse conducted interviews with attendees, capturing their memories and reflections.
The interviews for Jody's celebration of life were filmed over three hours.
